results/primary/protocol.json.bootstrap: 1000 recording-cluster paired resamples for fixed-vs-allmean contrasts; fixed query family, Holm correction is not used because no null-hypothesis testing is reported

results/diagnostics/supplemental_protoco.status: Exploratory diagnostic selected after the primary analysis
results/diagnostics/supplemental_protoco.split: Same fixed recording-ID split as the primary experiment
results/diagnostics/supplemental_protoco.ranking: Up to 50 smallest ID-hash anchors within each stratum; compare each policy with allmean using the same policy-covered split-wide neighbor universe and development scale
results/diagnostics/supplemental_protoco.pair_selection: Maximum development recordings with a common reported MD5 across two builds; then maximum development shared recording-MD5 pairs; lexicographic build pair breaks ties
results/diagnostics/supplemental_protoco.matched_build_contrast: Within each recording, average each build within every common reported MD5, contrast those averages, then give each recording equal weight
results/diagnostics/supplemental_protoco.interpretation: Reported digests are not independently validated audio; pair selection uses development support only; archive sample is not a known probability sample
